metrics.scope: One finite deterministic loopback fixture on CPU under fixed one-CPU/768MiB/64PID cap; no performance comparison.
metrics.p95_convention: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n); n=3 so this equals observed maximum, not an estimated population tail
metrics.controller_wall_scope: Includes eager formatter cold initialization, all worker startup/restarts, native work and fixed holds; ends before finally server.shutdown/server_close/thread.join and receipt serialization.
metrics.host_CLI_wall_scope: Docker invocation through process return, including suite teardown/lifecycle/output finalization; excludes earlier environment/cache preparation, freeze/audit, and subsequent absence query.
metrics.memory_peak_scope: Whole-container cgroup memory.peak read once after third worker return but before suite finally teardown; includes pre-sampling formatter startup, excludes any later teardown peak. Not a complete-lifetime or GPU peak.
metrics.observer_scope: Accumulated perf_counter duration around 436 two-file cgroup sample reads; excludes sleep, memory.peak read, later serialization and observer interactions; not causal overhead.
metrics.body_accounting_scope: All three fixture provider POST body pairs, persisted hashes, completed writes and native consumption agree; excludes HTTP headers, TCP, local interception, disk/cache and external network traffic.
metrics.scoring_retry_configuration: EchoTask default scoring.max_retries=2 is present in actual task traces; env/agent retries=0. Three saved score members and successful scoring intervals are observed, not separate instrumentation of every scorer invocation.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly three actual native episodes, one native trace and echoed score each, exactly three delivered provider POSTs bound to the expected reserved attempt/model/data; no failed or hidden arrival.
acceptance.evidence: Three exact native episode/traces, one successful call and echoed member each; all3perarrival request/response bytes, delivery-completion timestamps and exact native consumed content agree. No extra observed arrival artifact.

acceptance.criterion: Version mismatch changes neither ledger nor provider count; exact replay, identity conflict, over-budget development, final repeat and late development are refused.
acceptance.evidence: Version before/after snapshot bytes equal, no HTTP handling overlaps its monotonic interval. Seven additional negative controls are inline source assertions reached by phase2/3success paths; per-control snapshots and exception payloads are not independently logged.

acceptance.criterion: Winner committed before final-data read; no final observation is used to change candidates, budgets, evaluator or selection.
acceptance.evidence: Winner recomputed from completed development only; selection explicitly precedes final-data open and frozen evaluate code checks committed winner before read. This is logical separation for one trusted owner, not OS access auditing or sealed benchmark data.

acceptance.criterion: Three distinct worker PIDs, first two confirmed SIGKILL exits before next worker, third exit zero; all native runtime scopes closed at barriers.

acceptance.criterion: No re-run or threshold/auditor repair on the same freeze. A failure remains failed. Independent saved-byte and stopped-database review precedes any acceptance claim.
acceptance.evidence: One scientific intent/execution, frozen source/files preserved and independent saved-byte audit only. No same-freeze rerun, producer edit or threshold repair; v1failuremanifest/20hostfiles/22rawfiles/failed audit remain exact.

audit.acceptance_conclusion: All six frozen acceptance criteria supported for the declared one-owner finite deterministic native fixture, with direct saved-output evidence distinguished from inline-code success-path evidence.
audit.scientific_status: Finite native integration gate only; H3 full closed/adaptive-bias evaluation and H4 remain unmet. H1negative/original5GiB endpoint and H2history unchanged. No model quality, real model, GPU, distributed, production, performance-improvement or general exactly-once result.
missingness_and_limitations: Host saved named-container absence readback is verified; reviewer did not perform a new Docker query or reopen destroyed container/cache volumes. Two cache files rely on preexecution frozen verification rather than a fresh audit rehash.

Saved receipts and source attest sequential SIGKILL/wait and returned runtime scopes; no independent syscall, process-descendant or filesystem access trace exists. Final-open order is code-plus-receipt evidence, not a separate access monitor.

Seven refusal controls rely on unchanged inline assertions and successful workers, with stopped4rowDB corroboration. Individual exception/DB snapshots are absent except explicit version-mismatch snapshots.

Arrival recorder preserves attempt/data headers but does not persist a complete raw HTTP-header block or Authorization value. Request body hashes, models, attempt keys and dataset identity are independently reconciled; authentication testing is not claimed.

memory.peak endpoint and controller duration precede finally teardown; no complete-lifetime memory peak or dedicated teardown latency exists. Host CLI wall covers teardown and lifecycle but excludes separate preparation and audit.
436samples start after eager formatter initialization and stop before teardown. Samplemaximum is not truepeak; observer_read_seconds is measured file-read duration, not causal overhead.
No separate scorer invocation log; actual task default scoring retries2 remains unchanged and three final echoed members are observed. Synthetic provider token counts are not real token measurement.

Three latency observations do not establish a population tail, scaling behavior or comparative performance. No causal attribution of v1failure recovery to eager initialization alone; request-identity and initialization changed together.

Only two fixed crash boundaries, one trusted sequential owner and three allowance ceiling; no mid-provider/mid-scoring/power-loss/arbitrary schedule, concurrent owner, multi-session runtime, tenant authorization, idempotent external effects or production proof.
